title: Annotated status values omit the writing reminder
detail: Deferred risk: a synthetic status: backlog # approved is read as backlog by native Spacedock, while the passing seed check omits ASK_FORM. No annotated status exists among 192 pinned task files, and this scratch workflow did not expose an actionable ready gate. Material if the supported gate-preparation route produces/preserves this form or an adopter task uses it. Candidate bytes unchanged.
fix: Have FO disposition the risk; if the trigger is supported, consume the native parsed status.
